relation_semantics: positive-area geometric relation facts between exact parent Geography Releases
interpretation: A row states that one exact Census 2022 radio geometry and one exact IGN department geometry have positive overlap in the configured equal-area CRS. Multiple target matches, unmatched sources and unreferenced targets remain explicit facts.
known_limitations: The IGN parent is an official archive retrieved on 2026-08-26 whose embedded shapefile members carry November 2019 timestamps; no 2026 geometry vintage is inferred.
The IGN target layer includes Departamento, Partido and Comuna source labels under one second-order administrative layer and extends to the bicontinental/Antarctic representation.
Census radios are statistical units and IGN departments are administrative units. Positive overlap does not imply equal identity, legal hierarchy, or a preferred provider.
The relation uses geometry only. It does not allocate population or other Census measures across administrative units.
Source-invalid Census geometry remains observable through relation status rather than being silently repaired.
Two-sided overlap shares are quantitative geometry diagnostics; they are not assignment weights or a boundary-choice rule.
